                    played_together[p1][p2] = True
                    played_together[p2][p1] = True
        
        possible = True
        for w in range(1, n_weeks):
            # Try to build week w

                valid_groups = []

                        if can_add:

                if not valid_groups:

                # Pick a random valid group

                groups[g].append(p)
                schedule[w][p] = g
